SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.itgcms.sysmgmt.userauth.mapper.MgmtAuthGrpMapper.selectMenuNoListByAuthrtIds : 권한아이디로 부터 메뉴 번호 목록 조회 */ MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ FROM ( SELECT AM.MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AM.MENU_NO ORDER BY AM.MENU_NO ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM SAB300 AM /** 권한별 메뉴 */ , SAB400 AU /** 권한 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AM.AUTHRT_ID IN /* 권한아이디 (복수) */
#{authrtId}
AND AU.AUTHRT_ID = AM.AUTHRT_ID AND AU.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY AM.MENU_NO ASC ) T WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 /* 메뉴번호 중복제거 */

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID /* 사용자아이디 */ , AM.AUTHRT_ID /* 권한아이디 */ , M.MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ , NVL(AM.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 조회버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 초기화버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS REG_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 등록버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 수정버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 삭제버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 관리버튼사용여부 */ , NVL(AM.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN, 'N') AS DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN /* 상세조회버튼사용여부 */ , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AM.MENU_NO ORDER BY AM.MENU_NO ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM SAB200 M /** 메뉴 */ , SAB300 AM /** 권한별 메뉴 */ , SAB400 AU /** 권한 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AM.AUTHRT_ID IN /* 권한아이디 (복수) */
#{authrtId}
AND M.MENU_NO = AM.MENU_NO /* 메뉴번호 */ AND AU.AUTHRT_ID = AM.AUTHRT_ID /* 권한아이디 (권한구분코드 - AUTHRT_SE_CD 와 맵핑) */ AND AU.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 권한 삭제여부 */ ORDER BY AM.AUTHRT_ID, M.MENU_NO ASC ) T WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 /* 메뉴번호 중복제거 */
